# Asia Open Briefing: Supply Tightens, Prices Surge Fast  
**Bottom line:** Expect tighter lead times and higher pricing; lock in critical MOSFETs now, but weigh inventory for less‑urgent analog parts.

## What changed
- Market supply risk sits at **71.1** (‑0.1 change) and price trend at **85.5** (+0.1), both in the “Elevated” / “Rising fast” zone[1].  
- TSMC foundry loading up 50.9% YoY, pushing supply tighter across logic and advanced‑logic segments[3].  
- Global chip sales jumped 148.3% YoY to $172.6 B, feeding demand‑side pressure on both supply and price scores[2].  
- Semiconductor PPI rose 9.1% annualized over the last three months, a key driver of price escalation[1].  
- Fab utilization is 76.5%, slightly below the 10‑yr average but still high enough to keep capacity constrained[5].

## Featured part: IPB017N10N5ATMA1
- Lead time **14 weeks**, stock **27,081** units, no on‑order quantity disclosed.  
- Price **$5.56** for qty 1, **$2.51** for 1 k units.  
- Origin **Austria**, tariff **0 %** (no surcharge).  
- Supply risk **53.9** (Neutral) and price trend **69.3** (moderate rise).  
- Call: **Hold course** – 58 % chance prices rise, but no strong timing signal to buy ahead.

## Alerts

- Processors & advanced logic – **71.0** (0.0), price **82.1**, High confidence.

- **10M08SAE144C8G** – supply risk 86.0 (Severe); 52‑week lead time vs 12‑week norm.  
- **SN65HVD230DR** – supply risk 82.2; 26‑week lead time.  
- **LM358DR** – supply risk 82.0; 26‑week lead time.  
- **TPS62130RGTR** – supply risk 81.6; 26‑week lead time, price near target.

## Outlook
- **Chip prices, next 3 mo:** 66 % chance of rise, expected +2.17 % (80 % range ‑9.57 % to +13.91 %); model‑based edge tested.  
- **Chip prices, next 6 mo:** 52 % chance of rise, expected +4.34 % (‑8.79 % to +17.46 %); trend‑following baseline.
